versions.content: Parameters that are declared as optional in the ECU Con- figuration Definition may be left out in the ECU Configuration Value description If an ECU Configuration Parameter has specified a lowerMultiplicity < 1 an ECU Configuration Value may be left out in the ECU Configuration Value description because of being treated as optional.
